يلتقوا (form VIII)
# يَلْتَقُوا (yaltaqū) /jal.ta.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
# يُلْتَقَوْا (yultaqaw) /jul.ta.qaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
